selection: All 12 accepted linear_equation cases; 9 pairs and 2 single cases chosen after source review
execution_deviation: The initial full code build processed all 12 contracts and 11 qualitative cases before formal browser inspection. The planned 2-3-case visual pilot was not an execution gate. Source review preceded the build; targeted browser review followed the first build.
consequence: Treat as exploratory development, not blinded or independent held-out validation. Technical replay and exact source quotes do not establish pedagogical correctness.
independence: Interpretations and code checks authored by primary assistant; historical new-50 audits remain separate inputs, not fresh independent review of bridge contracts.
